eventDetail.scope: 2026 18th International Scientific Conference on Informatics is a biennial international forum which gives room for scientists, experts in computer science and professionals in new emerging fields of informatics to present original research results, to share experiences and to exchange ideas about transferring theoretical concepts into real life. The conference provides a unique opportunity for establishing and maintaining professional relationships of widely recognized scientists between each other in specific areas of computer science.
